title: India’s top richest and poorest states by GSDP in FY25
summary: Finance Ministry projects FY26 real GDP growth at 7.4%. Maharashtra highest GSDP at ₹45.32L Cr, followed by Tamil Nadu ₹31.19L Cr, UP ₹29.78L Cr.
